token_hygiene.instrument: PowerShell .NET regex with explicit non-word boundaries; counts occurrences, not matching lines
token_hygiene.collision_disposition: The seam-axis tokens pre-exist and are adopted with their established meanings. S0, S1, and S3 are generic local stage labels with canon collisions, so every use remains qualified by atom_layer0 stage context and none is proposed as a canonical term. Other atom_layer0-authored tokens have zero canon occupancy at the pinned vintage.

records.declared_layer: terminal result of one differently-derived splitter challenge over one versioned frontier
records.axis_intent: state why the splitter challenge terminated
precedence: NOT_EXERCISABLE applies only before a challenge begins when no differently-derived splitter exists
INSTRUMENT_UNKNOWN dominates every partial run state
DECOMPOSITION_FOUND dominates remaining frontier because one witness defeats the universal claim
BUDGET_EXHAUSTED_WITH_FRONTIER_OPEN applies when instruments worked but frontier remains
DECLARED_FRONTIER_EXHAUSTED applies only when every declared cell closes

postulates.mece: PASS: the precedence rule makes concurrent operational facts resolve to exactly one terminal; NOT_EXERCISABLE closes the no-run member that the four-value array omitted.
postulates.same_grain: PASS: every member describes one challenge run, never a concept or work item.
postulates.intent_coherence: PASS: every member answers only why the challenge terminated.
postulates.state_coherence: PASS: every member is re-evaluated by the same operation, rerun the challenge against the same declared frontier and current instruments; none is a hidden remediation class.

records.layer_coverage_probe: No-run, broken-instrument, witness, open-frontier, and closed-frontier terminals are all expressible.

records.declared_layer: operator that reconstructs one parent from independently meaningful children
records.axis_intent: classify the reconstruction operator, not the discovery method

postulates.mece: PASS: normalized children reconstruct either jointly (AND) or as alternatives (OR). A mixed expression is normalized into nested candidate nodes before classification.
postulates.same_grain: PASS: both members type one candidate's reconstruction operator.
postulates.intent_coherence: PASS: both answer only how children reconstruct the parent.
postulates.state_coherence: PASS: both are declarative operators with identical evidence and review lifecycle; neither is instrument-owned while the other is judgment-owned.

records.layer_coverage_probe: Products, bundles, alternative realizations, unions, and mixed expressions after normalization are covered.

records.declared_layer: evidence state of one S0-S5 stage at one run vintage
records.axis_intent: distinguish assessed evidence from empty, unreachable, and unattempted work

postulates.mece: PASS: a stage was completed with content, completed after a discriminating empty enumeration, attempted but unreachable, or not attempted.
postulates.same_grain: PASS: every member describes one stage in one run.
postulates.intent_coherence: PASS: every member answers the stage's evidence state, not its substantive verdict.
postulates.state_coherence: PASS: all members move under the same stage re-execution at a new evidence vintage; no value embeds an owner-specific remedy.

records.layer_coverage_probe: The correctly-empty/unreachable/not-looked distinction is explicit; no blank state remains.

records.declared_layer: diagnostic coordinate for one layer binding
records.axis_intent: separate physical traversal, map-to-territory agreement, and payload meaning
records.grain: one axis check on one binding

postulates.mece: PASS: connection, recorded claim, and carried meaning are disjoint questions and jointly cover whether the binding is sound.
postulates.same_grain: PASS: each member is one coordinate check on the same binding.
postulates.intent_coherence: PASS: all three serve binding soundness; none encodes disposition or owner.
postulates.state_coherence: PASS: each coordinate carries the same PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN evaluation lifecycle and is exercised in the same binding run; no axis is structurally unassessable by definition.

records.layer_coverage_probe: A binding that connects, is recorded, and carries meaning has no fourth soundness dimension in the adopted /seams contract.

records.declared_layer: admissibility of one normalized proposed split
records.axis_intent: decide whether the split enters the challenge frontier

postulates.mece: PASS: all required tests pass, at least one test fails, or required evidence is unavailable.
postulates.same_grain: PASS: each outcome binds one normalized split.
postulates.intent_coherence: PASS: outcomes answer frontier admission only.
postulates.state_coherence: PASS: all outcomes are recomputed by the same five-test predicate on evidence refresh.

records.layer_coverage_probe: Missing evidence remains unknown and cannot be silently coerced to inadmissible.

records.declared_layer: certificate eligibility for one concept run
records.axis_intent: decide whether the bounded atomicity certificate may exist
records.grain: one concept x grammar version x scope run

postulates.mece: PASS: every run either satisfies every issuance operand or the certificate is withheld with typed cause.
postulates.same_grain: PASS: both outcomes bind one run tuple.
postulates.intent_coherence: PASS: outcomes answer issuance only and do not assert that false means decomposable.
postulates.state_coherence: PASS: both outcomes are recomputed from the same frontier and instrument operands.

records.layer_coverage_probe: Every non-closed splitter result maps to false; only declared frontier exhaustion can map to true.

records.declared_layer: resolution state of one binding at one declared grain and HEAD vintage
records.axis_intent: decide whether the binding resolves exactly

postulates.mece: PASS: every operand passes, at least one known operand fails, or at least one required operand is unknown.
postulates.same_grain: PASS: each outcome binds one binding.
postulates.intent_coherence: PASS: outcomes answer exact resolution only.
postulates.state_coherence: PASS: all outcomes re-derive from the same binding operands and HEAD vintage.

records.layer_coverage_probe: Cardinality, pointer, content, grain, three seam axes, and code re-declaration are all operands; an unassessed operand cannot produce true.

records.declared_layer: ordered method stages in one atom_layer0 run
records.axis_intent: identify which transformation of the run bundle is executing

postulates.mece: PASS: pin, sweep, challenge, legislate, resolve, and prove are non-overlapping transformations and cover the method lifecycle.
postulates.same_grain: PASS: every member is one workflow stage.
postulates.intent_coherence: PASS: members identify execution position only, not result or evidence state.
postulates.state_coherence: PASS: every stage is governed by the same not-assessed/assessed/correctly-empty/unreachable state axis and the same re-entry rule.

records.layer_coverage_probe: Intake, decomposition generation, universal challenge, Rule 24 declaration, binding resolution, and live proving are all represented.

records.declared_layer: certificate existence for one concept x grammar version x scope run
records.axis_intent: state whether an atomicity certificate exists

postulates.mece: PASS: the certificate object either exists after all issuance operands pass or it does not.
postulates.same_grain: PASS: both values bind one run tuple.
postulates.intent_coherence: PASS: values state certificate existence only; WITHHELD does not assert decomposition.
postulates.state_coherence: PASS: both derive from the same issuance predicate on every validation.

records.layer_coverage_probe: No blank or pending certificate state exists; pending evidence is expressed by WITHHELD plus the typed splitter result.

records.declared_layer: primary mechanism by which one consumer binding reaches its authority
records.axis_intent: select the primary resolution mechanism for failure analysis

postulates.mece: PASS: each row declares one primary mechanism; compound implementations split into one row per binding leg rather than multi-labeling a row.
postulates.same_grain: PASS: all members type one binding leg.
postulates.intent_coherence: PASS: members state mechanism only; failure result and seam verdict stay separate.
postulates.state_coherence: PASS: all forms carry the same HEAD/content/grain/seam evaluation lifecycle and explicit loud/clean failure analysis.

records.layer_coverage_probe: Direct pointers, runtime/view compilation, and code or prose enum citation cover the three binding forms named by the founding brief.

records.declared_layer: method proving acceptance for one externally selected S5 run
records.axis_intent: decide whether the founding proving-run bar is satisfied

postulates.mece: PASS: all acceptance operands pass or acceptance is false with failed operands retained.
postulates.same_grain: PASS: both outcomes bind one S5 run.
postulates.intent_coherence: PASS: the predicate measures method proving acceptance only, not subject atomicity.
postulates.state_coherence: PASS: both outcomes derive from the same external-selection, defect, repair, and regression operands.
